a01_driver.title: Test driver structure and single line comments

a02_comments.title: Every comment form of the language, then a negative end

a03_print.title: print writes a string and a new line; no import is needed

a04_free_script.title: a free script: sequential statements, no driver and no process

a05_print_write.title: print adds a new line and separates its arguments with sep, write adds nothing; a list is one argument (Q-019b)

a06_new_set_let.title: new creates variables, set creates constants, let changes a value (D-076, D-079)

a08_logic.title: relation and logical operators, conditional statement and expression

a09_literals.title: literals of the primitive types (D-032, D-080)

a10_strings.title: strings are immutable UTF-8 text (D-058, D-080)

a11_interpolation.title: placeholders {name} and {name % format}: a name only, written by its type; \{ \} are literal braces; \u{} Unicode (D-096, D-102, formats are a draft)

a12_if.title: if, else if, else and the conditional statement (D-016)

a13_while.title: while loop with a header, break, else and then (D-030, D-033, D-034)

a14_for.title: for loop over ranges and collections (D-022)

a15_match.title: match with values, lists of values, ranges, other, then, one and all (D-016, D-030)

a16_ordinal.title: an Ordinal is a set of named integer values; the first value is 1 unless one is given (Q-029, D-096)

a17_list.title: list: literal, index, append, remove, capture, delete, builder, deconstruct (D-058 to D-060, D-077, D-079, D-096)

a18_array.title: array: literal, index, slice, view and clone, bulk assignment, builder (D-021, D-022, D-049, D-079)

a19_matrix.title: matrix: two indexes, last index, absolute index, [*] selects a dimension (D-058, D-064, D-079)

a20_dataset.title: DataSet: sorted unique values, union, intersection, difference (D-058)

a21_datamap.title: DataMap: a sorted map of key:value pairs; quoted or numeric keys (D-058, D-080)

a22_object.title: Object: unquoted keys make an object, quoted or numeric keys make a DataMap (D-058, D-080)

a23_clone_view.title: := shares a collection or an object, :: makes a deep copy, native values are always copied (D-049)

a24_function.title: functions: result, named arguments, default values, several results (D-028, D-070, D-086, D-087)

a25_procedure.title: procedures: no result, side effects, @ passes by reference, no @ passes a copy (D-048, D-086, D-100)

a26_class.title: class with a constructor, methods, visibility, reference and clone (D-076, D-084, D-085)

a27_text_literal.title: a text literal is raw and keeps the line breaks; the indentation of the closing quotes is removed (Q-014)

a28_regex.title: regular expressions: =~ matches, not (...) negates; a string that starts with / is a regex literal and keeps its backslashes (D-079, D-097)

a29_expect_fail.title: a failed expect ends the process with exit code 2 (D-010)

a30_over.title: over ends the process it is in with exit code 0

a31_recover.title: an error jumps to recover; reaching the end of recover handles the error (D-020)

a32_finalize.title: finalize runs after the process ends normally, and after recover (D-020)

a33_over_finalize.title: over skips recover but runs finalize: a clean exit never skips cleanup (D-081)

a34_jobs.title: jobs: retry runs a failed job again, resume goes on after it (D-020, D-034)

a35_index_error.title: index 0 is an error: indexes start at 1 (D-021)

a36_map_key_error.title: += on a missing key of a map raises an error (D-058)

a37_division_error.title: a division by zero raises an error, also for Real: no infinity, no NaN (Q-019a)

a38_matrix_index.title: matrix and tensor indexes: [x, y] is the same as [x][y]; a range selects a part (D-064)

a39_repeat.title: loop tested at the end: loop … do … repeat [while c]; and skip (D-074)

a40_extension_method.title: an extension method: declared outside the class, first parameter @self with the class type (D-086)

a41_inheritance.title: a subclass builds its object through the constructor of its superclass (D-084)

a42_visibility.title: a private member is seen only inside its class (D-085)

a43_let_creates_name.title: let changes names and creates the ones that are missing, by type inference (Q-017, D-096)

a44_bare_assignment.title: a change without let is a syntax error (D-076)

a45_redeclare.title: redeclaring a name in the same scope is an error (D-076)

a46_light_assignment.title: = is the light assignment of a declaration; it never changes a variable (D-079)

a47_string_plus_number.title: + between a string and a number is a type error; <+ converts the number (D-080)

a48_single_quote_text.title: a rune holds one code point; 'one' is a lexical error (D-063)

a49_stop_in_job.title: stop ends a job without error; the process goes on with the next statement (D-020)

a50_exit.title: exit ends the process without error and runs finalize (D-020)

a51_unhandled_error.title: an error without recover ends the process with the exit code 4, after finalize (D-081)

a52_assert.title: a failed assert is an error with code 3: the process stops when it is not recovered (Q-031h, D-096)

a53_abort.title: abort in recover ends the process, runs finalize and passes the error on (D-020)

a54_panic.title: panic ends the whole application at once with code 1, without finalize (D-038)

a55_attribute_outside.title: code outside a class can't add an attribute to an object (Q-019h, Q-031k, D-096)

a56_recursion.title: a function can call itself: Fibonacci (from demo/fibonacci.eve, D-099)

a57_conversion.title: explicit conversions do what the developer asked: floor, ceiling, round, parse (D-080; from demo/explicit_coercion.eve and demo/string_to_number.eve, D-099)

a58_rune_range.title: a range of runes: ('a'..'c') visits the code points in order (from demo/symbol_range.eve, D-099)

a59_optional_null.title: a variable without a value has the zero value of its type, never null; an optional type T? may hold null (D-080; from demo/null_strings.eve, D-099)

a60_process_args.title: the process receives the command-line arguments; a vararg collects them, * spreads a list (D-029, D-040; from demo/method_call.eve and demo/test_args.eve, D-099)

a61_variant.title: a variant type holds one of the listed types and takes the type of the value assigned (from demo/variant_type.eve and demo/variant_params.eve, D-099)

a62_multi_line.title: a statement ends with ; so an expression or a literal may span several lines (from demo/multi_line.eve, D-099)

a63_range_domain.title: a range is a domain of values: limits included or excluded, open ends, a step that sets the precision (D-022; from demo/domain_demo.eve and demo/numeric_range.eve, D-099)

a64_function_without_result.title: a function must have a result: a subprogram without result is declared with procedure (D-100)

a65_procedure_bang.title: a procedure is made for side effects and is never deterministic: it never ends with ! (D-101)

a66_bad_placeholder.title: in a string every unescaped brace opens a placeholder {name}; a literal brace is \{ or \} (D-102)

a67_procedure_in_class.title: a class hosts functions, not procedures: the work that changes things is done by methods (D-103)

a68_undefined_name.title: an undefined name is a compile error: the script does not start (D-110)

a69_exit_procedure.title: exit in a procedure leaves only the procedure; the process goes on (D-111)

a70_over_procedure.title: over in a procedure ends the whole process, not only the procedure (D-111)

a71_param_order.title: a mandatory parameter may follow optional ones, and the call then names it (D-106)

a72_named_required.title: a parameter after optional parameters can't be positional: the call must name it (D-106)

a73_vararg_function.title: a vararg collects the rest of the arguments; an optional parameter after it is named (D-029)

a74_defer.title: defer runs when the subprogram ends, by any path, in reverse order (D-081)

a75_raise_code.title: raise "text" creates an error with code 4 and that message (D-054, D-109)

a76_overflow.title: integer overflow is an error with its own code, 13 (D-109)

a77_system_variable.title: a driver can set a system variable and define its own $name (D-109)

a78_digit_separator.title: the digit separator _ is not accepted in a number: a lexical error (Q-013, D-095)

a79_procedure_in_expression.title: a procedure has no value: it can't be used in an expression (D-100)

a80_let_capture_loop.title: in a loop a capture creates its name once: the next turns assign it, they do not create it again (D-104)

a81_let_undeclared.title: let creates a missing name only in a capture: let y := 5 with no y is an error (D-104)

a82_list_ends.title: list modifiers: <+ appends at the end, +> puts in front; the list stays after +> and before <+ (D-107)
